aka.zh: 福厦公路（福州至厦门段）
广汕公路（广州至汕头段）

tagline.en: Along the south China coast from Fuzhou to Guangzhou and inland to Kunming, on roads first built county by county with merchants' money in the 1920s
tagline.zh: 从福州沿华南海岸到广州，再向内陆直抵昆明；沿线不少路段是 20 世纪 20 年代由各县以商民集资分段修起来的

start.en: The Juhua interchange, Guandu, Kunming, Yunnan
start.zh: 云南省昆明市官渡区菊华立交

end.zh: 福建省福州市仓山区白湖亭

en: G324 runs from Fuzhou to Kunming through Fujian, Guangdong, Guangxi, Guizhou and Yunnan. Chinese Wikipedia gives 2,517.289 km in its text and 2,712 km in its mileage table, the length also listed for the 1981 route. The first third keeps to the coast: Putian, Hui'an, Quanzhou, Tong'an, Zhangzhou, Zhangpu, Yunxiao and Zhao'an in Fujian, then Raoping, Chenghai, Shantou, Chaoyang, Puning, Lufeng, Haifeng, Huidong, Huizhou, Boluo and Zengcheng to Guangzhou. West of Guangzhou it turns inland by Nanhai, Sanshui, Zhaoqing, Yunfu and Luoding, through Cenxi, Rong county, Beiliu, Yulin, Guigang and Binyang to Nanning, up the You river valley by Long'an, Tiandong and Tianyang to Baise and Tianlin, across south-western Guizhou by Ceheng, Anlong and Xingyi, and into Yunnan by Luoping, Shizong, Shilin and Yiliang to Kunming.

Two of its stretches have their own names. Fuzhou to Xiamen is the Fuzhou–Xiamen road, for decades the main road of coastal Fujian; Guangzhou to Shantou is the Guangzhou–Shantou road, the main overland route from Guangzhou to eastern Guangdong and Fujian before the expressways. In Guangzhou the road shares Guangzhou Avenue and the Guangzhou and Luoxi bridges with G105.
zh: G324 自福州至昆明，途经福建、广东、广西、贵州、云南。中文维基百科正文记全长 2517.289 公里，里程表则至 2712 公里，即 1981 年线路的里程。前三分之一沿海而行：福建境内经莆田、惠安、泉州、同安、漳州、漳浦、云霄、诏安，广东境内经饶平、澄海、汕头、潮阳、普宁、陆丰、海丰、惠东、惠州、博罗、增城到广州。过广州后转向内陆，经南海、三水、肇庆、云浮、罗定，穿过岑溪、容县、北流、玉林、贵港、宾阳到南宁，沿右江河谷经隆安、田东、田阳到百色、田林，横越黔西南的册亨、安龙、兴义，再经云南罗平、师宗、石林、宜良抵昆明。
其中两段各有专名。福州至厦门段称福厦公路，几十年间是福建沿海的主干道；广州至汕头段称广汕公路，是高速公路通车前广州通往粤东及福建的陆路交通大动脉。在广州，它与 G105 共线走广州大道，共用广州大桥和洛溪大桥。

en: The Guangzhou–Shantou road was assembled from county roads built under official supervision with private money. Its oldest piece, from Huizhou's south gate to Pingshan, was begun in November 1920 on the line of an old post road, paid for with 100,000 yuan of famine-relief work, 160,000 raised in shares in Huizhou and the rest from the province; it opened as far as Ma'an on 1 May 1921, Huizhou's first road. Zengcheng's west gate to Libo'ao, planned in 1928 and opened in 1931, was paid for partly by 1,000 shares of 200 silver yuan each sold by a private company and partly by a provincial subsidy of 108,600. From 21 November 1933 buses could run from Leikou to Huizhou, and the opening of the Guangzhou–Shantou road was celebrated at Leikou on 8 March 1934; the last gap, from Queshi to Leikou outside Shantou, was closed only in November 1945. A 1936 survey listed it at 413.3 km, the first trunk of the province's eastern roads. It was broken up in 1938 against the Japanese and restored after the war.

The Fuzhou–Xiamen road was begun in 1926 and, according to the Fuzhou Daily, was still unfinished on the eve of 1949. With the coast blockaded, it became the main supply line for coastal defence, and it was completed in early 1951 to the old 'class 6B' standard on a roadbed 6 to 8 m wide. A Fuqing local-history account says that the road was destroyed in November 1938 and made a national road in July 1947; this account has not been checked against an official source.

In the 1980s houses and markets lined the road so closely that it became a byword for dirt, disorder and jams. In 1983 and again in 1990 the Fujian party committee and government called for the army, police and public to rebuild it together as a 'civilised road'. The first campaign took four years, shortened the road by 6.3 km and brought it to class-II standard with separate lanes for slow traffic, raising the average speed to 45 km/h. The second, from 20 February 1990, brought in more than 30,000 soldiers; Fuzhou to Xiamen then took about eleven hours. By the early 1990s the road carried a quarter of Fujian's road transport and more than 13,000 vehicles a day against a design capacity of 7,000. From 1 June 1994 the five coastal prefectures widened 485 km from Fuzhou through Putian, Quanzhou and Xiamen to Zhangzhou to six lanes on a 23 m road. That August the provincial party secretary brought the deadline forward by more than five months, to before the 1995 Spring Festival; the road was finished on 21 January 1995, and Fuzhou–Xiamen came down to about six and a half hours.
zh: 广汕公路由各县官督民办、商民集资修建的公路连接而成。最早的一段是惠州南门至平山的惠平公路，1920 年 11 月以旧驿路为基础动工，经费为以工代赈 10 万元、惠州各界认股筹 16 万元，余由省财政厅和公路处补足；1921 年 5 月 1 日通车至马安，是惠州市境的第一条公路。增城县城西门至李伯坳段 1928 年筹建、1931 年通车，资金部分来自利群公司向民间发行的 1000 股股票（每股 200 元毫银），部分为广东省财政厅补助的 10.86 万元（毫银）。自 1933 年 11 月 21 日起可由磊口乘车直达惠州，1934 年 3 月 8 日在磊口补行广汕通车典礼；汕头附近𬒈石至磊口的最后一段，迟至 1945 年 11 月才修通。1936 年的《粤省公路之现势》记其全长 413.3 公里，为省道东路的第一干线。1938 年为阻止日军进攻被全面破坏，战后修复。
福厦公路始建于 1926 年，据《福州日报》，直到解放前夕全线仍未修通。由于海上被封锁，它成为巩固海防的主要运输线，1951 年初按老六级乙标准全线修成通车，路基宽 6 至 8 米。福清一份地方史料称，该路 1938 年 11 月被毁，1947 年 7 月划归国道；该说法未与官方资料核对。

到 20 世纪 80 年代，沿路建房、依路建街使福厦公路脏、乱、堵现象严重。福建省委、省政府于 1983 年、1990 年先后发出整治福厦公路、军警民共建福厦文明路的号召。第一次整治历时四年，缩短里程 6.3 公里，全线基本达到二级路标准，实行快慢车分道行驶，平均时速提高到 45 公里。第二次自 1990 年 2 月 20 日开始，驻闽部队先后出动 3 万多名官兵；此后从福州到厦门车程约 11 个小时。当时福厦公路承担全省 25％的公路运输量，日均交通量 1.3 万多辆，大大超过 7000 辆的设计标准。1994 年 6 月 1 日，沿线五地市同时开工拓宽福州经莆田、泉州、厦门至漳州的 485 公里，路宽 23 米、六车道。当年 8 月，时任省委书记贾庆林决定全线工期提前至 1995 年春节前完成，工期缩短了 5 个多月；1995 年 1 月 21 日全线贯通，福州到厦门车程缩短为约六个半小时。

en: No cost exists for the road as a whole. The sums recorded for the Fuzhou–Xiamen campaigns are modest: the Fuzhou Daily puts the first, from 1983, at about 100 million yuan, and in the second the cities, counties, townships and villages along the road raised 6 million yuan for 20 bus stops, 19 refuse sites, 15 markets and 35 public toilets, while the provincial highway department spent more than 37 million over three years, widening 12 narrow stretches and laying 54 km of concrete. The Huizhou section of the Guangzhou–Shantou road, 146.4 km, was rebuilt in 1991–1992 and handed to a company set up to run it.
zh: 全线没有总造价。福厦公路历次整治的记载金额并不大：据《福州日报》，1983 年起的第一次整治耗资约 1 亿元；第二次整治中，沿线市、县、乡（镇）和村共集资 600 万元，建成 20 个停车站、19 座垃圾场、15 个农贸市场、35 座公厕，省公路部门 3 年投资 3700 多万元，拓宽 12 条“羊肠小道”，铺设水泥路面 54 公里。广汕公路惠州段 146.4 公里于 1991—1992 年改造，并成立广东广汕公路惠州段有限公司经营管理。

why.en: No cost exists for the whole road. It joins roads built from 1920 onwards by counties, merchants and provinces across five provinces, and has been rebuilt section by section since; the sums recorded for individual works are given below.
why.zh: 全线没有总造价。它由 1920 年以来五省各县、商民和省政府修建的道路连缀而成，此后又分段改建；下列为单项工程有记载的金额。

why.en: No route-wide funding statement exists. The early Guangdong sections were built under official supervision with shares sold to merchants and residents, government money and provincial subsidies; the 1990 Fuzhou–Xiamen campaign was paid by the towns along the road and the provincial highway department.
why.zh: 未见全线出资说明。广东早期路段以官督民办方式修建，资金来自向商民发行的股票、政府投资和省级补助；1990 年的福厦文明路整治由沿线市县乡村和省公路部门出资。

timeline.en: The Huizhou–Pingshan road opens as far as Ma'an on 1 May.
timeline.zh: 5 月 1 日，惠平公路通车至马安。

timeline.en: Work on the Fuzhou–Xiamen road begins.
The opening of the Guangzhou–Shantou road is celebrated at Leikou on 8 March.
timeline.zh: 3 月 8 日，在磊口补行广汕公路通车典礼。

timeline.en: The Guangzhou–Shantou road is broken up to slow the Japanese advance.
timeline.zh: 为阻止日军进攻，广汕公路被全面破坏。

timeline.en: The Fuzhou–Xiamen road is completed in early 1951.
timeline.zh: 年初，福厦公路全线修成通车。

timeline.en: The national trunk highway plan of November names Fuzhou–Kunming as G324.
timeline.zh: 11 月，《国家干线公路网（试行方案）》将福州至昆明公路编为 324 国道。

timeline.en: Fujian launches the first 'civilised road' rebuilding of the Fuzhou–Xiamen road.
timeline.zh: 福建发出整治福厦公路、共建文明路的号召。

timeline.en: The second campaign begins on 20 February, with more than 30,000 soldiers.
timeline.zh: 2 月 20 日，第二次共建福厦文明路开始，驻闽部队出动 3 万多名官兵。

timeline.en: The rebuilding of the Huizhou section of the Guangzhou–Shantou road is finished in December.
timeline.zh: 12 月，广汕公路惠州段改造完成。

timeline.en: The six-lane widening from Fuzhou to Zhangzhou is finished on 21 January.
timeline.zh: 1 月 21 日，国道 324 线福厦漳段六车道改造工程全线贯通。
